status: The two production calls use pinned nix safe wrappers. Independent reviews found no code defects or scope creep; their stale-evidence finding is corrected here. The replacement full local gate passed; native validation remains pending.
replacement: Pinned nix 0.31.3 with fs/feature only. c_path preserves NUL truncation; OwnedFd::into_raw_fd preserves ownership transfer, and OsStringExt::into_vec preserves bytes. No public API or version change. Two lexical unsafe blocks are deleted; expected native_unix spans decrease Linux 20 to 16 and macOS 18 to 14.

baseline_defect: Bug #140: original native run 38969720776 failed three macOS fixtures, before production replacement. Invalid UTF-8 creation returned EILSEQ (92), and a zero-X mkstemp template succeeded instead of returning EINVAL. Both Linux targets passed. The corrected tests separate portable creation, filesystem-probed invalid-byte behavior and platform-specific zero-X contracts, retaining coverage rather than normalizing production behavior.
darwin_template_source: https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/Libc/blob/71bbe350ab79eef58113991d817ccc6165061a64/stdio/FreeBSD/mktemp.c — find_temp_path randomizes trailing Xs but does not require any; mkstemp and mkdtemp both call it. Empty templates are rejected before the action. This supports the observed zero-X result and the corrected empty-template error fixture.
corrected_local_validation: All six temporary-path fixtures and cargo xtask pr passed against unchanged production on Linux (/tmp/martensite-temporary-platform-baseline.log and /tmp/martensite-temporary-corrected-pr.log). Corrected native results are recorded in completed_baseline; #140 awaits integration.
existing_capabilities: Existing rustix 1.1.5 has no mkstemp/mkdtemp wrapper in its source. The existing tempfile dependency uses OpenOptions and its own name generation, rather than forwarding the supplied libc template. That is not a demonstrated exact replacement for these interfaces.

candidate.source: Inspected registry source src/unistd.rs: mkstemp at line 2279 and mkdtemp at line 2321.
candidate.behavior: Copies a NUL-terminated template, calls the corresponding libc function once, removes the trailing NUL and returns raw path bytes through PathBuf. mkstemp returns an OwnedFd; into_raw_fd can preserve the toolkit's existing ownership transfer without adding first-party unsafe. Pre-normalizing through c_path is required to preserve first-NUL truncation.
candidate.caution: The separately recorded nix directory-stream issue #126 does not justify using its directory API here; this change uses only the two inspected temporary-path wrappers. Dependency audits passed. Unknown injected errno values are not covered by the ordinary native-error fixtures.
